# Islam & Associates International — Extended Legal Context & Factsheet

## Overview
Islam & Associates International is a distinguished law firm established in 1997 in Dhaka, Bangladesh. With over 27 years of experience and three generations of legal heritage, the firm represents domestic corporations, multinational enterprises, expatriates, and private individuals.

## Official Entity Details
- **Organization Name**: Islam & Associates International
- **Alternate Names**: Islam & Associates, ইসলাম অ্যান্ড অ্যাসোসিয়েটস ইন্টারন্যাশনাল, Islam and Associates International Law Offices
- **Head Office**: 1st Floor, 30 Court House Street, Dhaka 1000, Bangladesh
- **Year Established**: 1997
- **Primary Jurisdictions**:
  - Supreme Court of Bangladesh (Appellate Division & High Court Division)
  - Dhaka District & Sessions Court, Metropolitan Magistrate Courts
  - Labour Courts, Administrative Tribunals, Company Bench, and Admiralty Courts
  - Cross-border arbitration and international compliance

## Detailed Practice Areas & Scope of Work

### 1. Corporate & Commercial Advisory
- Company Incorporation & Joint Ventures in Bangladesh (BIDA registration, RJSC filings)
- Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) advisory, foreign exchange regulations, repatriation of profits
- Cross-border mergers, acquisitions, corporate restructuring, and due diligence
- Drafting, reviewing, and negotiating high-value commercial agreements and supplier contracts

### 2. Civil Litigation & Real Estate Law
- Land ownership disputes, title verification, deed registration, and mutation
- Specific performance of contracts, mortgage disputes, and recovery of possession
- Permanent and temporary injunctions before district courts and the High Court Division
- High-stakes arbitration, mediation, and alternative dispute resolution (ADR)

### 3. Criminal Litigation & White-Collar Defense
- Representation in trial courts and appellate advocacy before the High Court Division
- Financial crime defense: Money laundering, anti-corruption (ACC) inquiries, cheque dishonour (NI Act Sec. 138)
- Pre-arrest, anticipatory, and regular bail petitions; criminal revisions and quashment proceedings

### 4. Immigration & Cross-Border Mobility
- Bangladesh work permits, executive visas, PI & NVR visas for foreign nationals and investors
- Immigration appeals, judicial reviews, citizenship declarations, and consular interventions
- Emigration legal clearances and overseas business relocation

### 5. Family, Custody & Succession Law
- Matrimonial litigation, divorce proceedings, guardianship, and child custody disputes
- Muslim personal law, succession certificates, probate of wills, and partition suits
- Settlement of family trusts, endowments, and ancestral property distributions

### 6. Banking, Finance, VAT & Taxation
- Artha Rin Adalat (Money Loan Court) representation for banking institutions and borrowers
- Loan syndication agreements, collateral securitization, and recovery proceedings
- Income tax appellate tribunals, National Board of Revenue (NBR) disputes, and VAT litigation

### 7. Intellectual Property (IP) Law
- Trademark, copyright, patent, and industrial design registration in Bangladesh
- Anti-counterfeiting actions, cease-and-desist notices, and IP infringement litigation

## Heritage & International Training
- Senior counsel and founder trained and certified with international legal bodies:
  - Harvard University (Internet Law)
  - Central Law Training, England
  - Kensington University, USA
  - Neil Weinrib PC, New York, USA
  - Ashley Bean & Co. Solicitors, London, England
- Track record: Over 500+ successful cases litigated, consulted, or settled.

## Online Features & Portal
- **Client Portal & Live Case Tracking**: Secure dashboard for real-time case updates, hearing schedules, and advocate communications.
- **Consultation Scheduler**: Allows booking both in-person chamber consultations in Dhaka and virtual consultations worldwide.
- **Bilingual Interface**: Full support in English and Bengali (বাংলা).
